text.from: 182 NFL WRs ranked by projection minus your line (56.5 rec yds). Type your book's line to recheck. "Over" columns count games above the line. Opp rank: 1 = the defense that allows the least to WRs (red), last = allows the most (green). Tap a player for his full log.
